introduction: DC’s earned income tax credit is a refundable tax credit for eligible workers. Claim it through the District’s individual income-tax return.
description: DC’s earned income tax credit is a refundable tax credit for eligible workers. Claim it through the District’s individual income-tax return.

sections.who: Federal EITC eligibility generally qualifies a filer for the DC credit. DC-specific expansions can cover certain other filers, including qualifying ITIN holders; use D-40 instructions.
sections.get: For tax year 2025, OTR states the credit equals 100% of federal EITC. Refund delivery options depend on the year and amount.
sections.docs:
• Federal return and EITC calculation.
  • Income, tax identification and qualifying-child records.
  • The correct tax year’s D-40 return and instructions.
sections.apply:
1. Check the filing-year instructions

    Use OTR’s DC EITC page and linked D-40 guidance.

  2. Complete D-40

    Apply standard or expanded eligibility rules as appropriate.

  3. Review refund options

    Before choosing installments, ask how recurring payments might affect other benefits.
sections.after: Retain the calculation and any OTR notice. Earlier years have different payment rules; do not assume the 2025 treatment applies to every return.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using OTR EITC rules and payment guidance. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Some can under DC-specific rules in D-40 instructions.
